criteria.no: There is a plausible implementation that satisfies one statement but not the other.
criteria.unclear: The statements are too ambiguous to determine whether their compliance sets are the same.
criteria.yes: Any implementation that satisfies one statement necessarily satisfies the other, and violating one violates the other.

dedupe-a-equivalent-constraint.instructions: Do a.statement and b.statement express the same testable constraint? Compare statements only; provenance quotes do not make anchors duplicates or distinct.

criteria.no: At least one statement can hold while the other does not.
criteria.yes: Each statement entails the other constraint.

dedupe-b-mutual-entailment.instructions: Considering only a.statement and b.statement, do the two constraints mutually entail each other? Ignore wording and quote overlap.

criteria.no: Yes; their obligations differ enough to receive different outcomes.
criteria.unclear: The obligations are too unclear to compare reliably.
criteria.yes: No; their obligations have the same compliance outcome in every relevant case.

dedupe-c-separate-outcomes.instructions: Could a plan or implementation receive different compliance outcomes for a.statement and b.statement? Judge their testable obligations, not their quotes.

a.statement: Every CLI command must emit JSON to stdout.

b.statement: Every CLI command must emit JSON to stdout.
